name: Varianza de Longitud de Oración
description: Analiza longitud de oración distribución for AI detección.
useCase: Identificación de texto IA mediante estructura oracional uniforme
mechanism: Mide the coeficiente of variation in row-level energy patrones as a proxy for longitud de oración diversity. AI tends to produce sentences of more uniform length.
source: Uchendu et al. (2020) - Authorship Attribution for Neural Text Generation, EMNLP
parameters: Tamaño de ventana: adaptativo, Quantization: 8-64 levels, Metrics: entropía, CV, correlación
strengths:
- Effective for detecting generado por IA text
- Language-agnostic estadístico approach
- Works with any text length
- Low computational overhead
limitations:
- Less effective on edited or paraphrased AI text
- Domain-specific content may trigger falsos positivos
- Short texts provide less reliable signals
- Performance varies a través de estilo de escrituras

references.title: Uchendu et al. (2020) - Authorship Attribution for Neural Text Generation, EMNLP
Guo, B. et al. (2023). How Close is ChatGPT to Human Experts? Comparison Corpus, Evaluation, and Detection. arXiv.
Ippolito, D. et al. (2020). Automatic Detection of Generated Text is Easiest when Humans are Fooled. ACL.
